name: lti-moodle-integration
description: LTI 1.3 tool provider for Express with Vue 3 / React 18 UI: Moodle (or any LMS) launch to app session, Deep Linking, and AGS grade passback.
author: Dr. Carson Hung

scripts.prepare: npm run clean && npm run build

notes.ltijs: REQUIRED. The LTI 1.3 Provider engine. Stores its own platform/nonce state in MongoDB (LTI_DB_URL).
notes.jsonwebtoken: REQUIRED. Used by the example adapters' generateJwt() to mint app-session JWTs. If your project already has its own JWT helper, you can drop this.
notes.express: REQUIRED (in the host app). Listed here as a hard dep so the types match. The standalone module's API surface uses Express 4 types; hosts on Express 5 bridge the gap with a one-line cast at the integration boundary.
notes.mongoose: OPTIONAL. Only needed if you use the Mongoose adapter / Mongoose models.
notes.drizzle-orm: OPTIONAL. Only needed if you use the Drizzle adapter.
notes.pg: OPTIONAL. Postgres driver — only needed with Drizzle adapter (or other raw-SQL setup).
notes.vue / vue-router / axios: OPTIONAL peer deps for the frontend bits. Required only if you copy the Vue components (frontend/src/views/) into your frontend project.
notes.react / react-dom / react-router-dom: OPTIONAL peer deps for the React frontend bits (frontend/src/react/). Required only if you copy the React components instead of the Vue ones. Install only the framework you actually use — the other one's peers stay unmet without npm errors.
